simple.meaning: מֵסַב (mêçab) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a divan (as enclosing the room); abstractly (adverbial) around.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 5 times across 1 Kings, 2 Kings, Job, Psalms, Song of Solomon, beginning at 1 Kings 6:29. Its contexts include kingship, priesthood.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מֵסַב (H4524).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: מֵסַב (mêçab) / H4524 is traced through 1 Kings 6:29, 2 Kings 23:5, Job 37:12, Psalms 140:10 as a generated source-based concept entry.

structuredEvidence.definition: a divan (as enclosing the room); abstractly (adverbial) around

firstOccurrence.englishText: He carved all the walls of the house around with carved figures of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, inside and outside.

timeline.evidenceText: He carved all the walls of the house around with carved figures of cherubim, palm trees, and open flowers, inside and outside.

He got rid of the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Judah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Judah, and in the places around Jerusalem; those also who burned incense to Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the army of the sky.
It is turned around by his guidance,
Let burning coals fall on them.

definitions.short: a divan (as enclosing the room); abstractly (adverbial) around
definitions.usage: that compass about, (place) round about, at table.
definitions.full: H4524. mesab or mesibbim or mesibboth מֵסַב noun [masculine] that which surrounds, or is round ; — 1. a. plural surrounding places , ׳יְרוּשׁ מְסִבֵּי 2Kin 23:5 places round about Jerusalem . b. as adverb מֵסַב round about 1Kin 6:29 ; feminine plural מְסִבּוֺת on all sides, in all directions , Job 37:12 (of cloud Di < of lightning Bu Du). 2 suffix מְסִבּוֺ Song 1:12 dubious: round table Ew De; cushion, divan Bae Kau; compare on all these Bu. — מְסִבָּ֑י Psa 140:10 see סבב Hiph`il
definitions.rootNote: plural masculine מְסִבִּים ; or feminine מְסִבּוֹת ; from 5437 ;
